message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.inc: Wait for Tensura to finish the character reset before beginning new progression.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.for: Live according to your convictions, develop a path, and seek a Great Crystal Altar when your soul is ready.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.see: Sage is the beginning of the shrine progression and the first step toward Great Sage.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.awa: Awaken Sage at a Great Crystal Shrine
Craft a Soul Resonator, locate a shrine, meet the altar requirements, and complete the ritual.
Prepare an authority that can empower others
Keep mastering skills, developing your existence, and building genuine bonds with subordinates. Granter may awaken when that authority matures.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.evo: Develop Granter toward an Ultimate authority
Use Grant and Take Back, master Granter, strengthen your subordinate network, and choose whether your authority becomes benevolent or absolute.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.ben: Bestow power, support multiple subordinates, reclaim grants at range, borrow without stripping the original, and inspect nearby allies.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.stage.abs: Invest power, command multiple subordinates, reclaim grants globally within loaded range, seize authority, and inspect your followers.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.recogniti: This incarnation's recognition is committed. Its title and rewards remain fixed until a true character reset.
Your actions are still shaping the recognition this incarnation may receive.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.authority: Authority history: %s successful grants, %s recognized subordinates.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.help_hint: Use /moostensura help for the compact command list.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.sage.head: Sage Progression
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.sage.goal: Goal: evolve Sage into Great Sage through a Great Crystal Altar ritual.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.sage.step: 3. Right-click the Soul Resonator while you have Sage.
4. Follow its needle to a Great Crystal Shrine when one answers.
5. Meet the ritual requirements and interact with the Great Crystal Altar.
6. Endure the ritual while Sage analyzes the altar and petitions for evolution.
7. A successful ritual awakens Sage into Great Sage.
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.sage.requ: XP cost on success: %s relative levels
message.moostensuraaddon.guide.sage.tip: Normal progression happens through the shrine ritual. Direct Sage upgrade tools remain restricted to authorized debug use.
